answer: On an attestation graph, trust propagates through random walks capped at length L, limiting how far attestations can carry influence. If a sybil set S has conductance Φ(S)=cut(S,V\S)/vol(S) near zero, little trusted walk mass enters it; its aggregate voting weight is therefore bounded by that crossing mass, not its internal node count. A trellis of reciprocal sybil links cannot manufacture external trust: even jade and haven gain weight only through attestations crossing the cut.
